title: Capitals That Are Not the Largest City
intro: Many capitals are smaller than another city in the same country. Can you tell which?

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Australia? (It is not the biggest city.)
questions.explain: Canberra is the capital; Natural Earth lists a larger population estimate for Sydney.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Canada? (It is not the biggest city.)
questions.explain: Ottawa is the capital; Natural Earth lists a larger population estimate for Toronto.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Brazil? (It is not the biggest city.)

questions.prompt: What is the capital of New Zealand? (It is not the biggest city.)

questions.prompt: What is the capital of United States of America? (It is not the biggest city.)

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Myanmar? (It is not the biggest city.)
questions.explain: Naypyidaw is the capital; Natural Earth lists a larger population estimate for Yangon.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Viet Nam? (It is not the biggest city.)
questions.explain: Hanoi is the capital; Natural Earth lists a larger population estimate for Ho Chi Minh City.

questions.prompt: In which of these countries is the capital also the largest city?
questions.explain: Tokyo is both the capital and the largest city of Japan, while Canberra, Ottawa and Brasília are each smaller than another city in their country.
